title: AJ
body: The Architects' Journal is a weekly architectural magazine published in London by Emap. The first edition was produced in 1896. Commonly referred to by architects as the AJ, its articles concentrate mainly on British architecture unlike its sister publication the Architectural Review, which has a worldwide focus. The subjects written about include daily architectural news, studies of British buildings and detailed technical & practice features. In 2011, the Architects' Journal launched the AJ Buildings Library, a digital database containing images and drawings of over 1,000 exemplar projects built in the UK.
